title: E2E: peer discovery, contact EventSource refresh, block/unblock
description:
End-to-end validation of the full auto-discovery feature.

What: Integration test + manual test plan verification.

Algorithm:
1. Run cargo test --workspace --features test-utils. All tests must pass.
2. Run cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings. Zero warnings.
3. Run cargo fmt --all. No changes.
4. Write and run an integration test (kithd integration test pattern used in prior epics):
   - Start two kithd test harnesses (A and B) in the same process with a mock TailscaleClient
   - Mock A's tslocal.status() to return B's IP in the Peer map
   - Mock B's /.well-known/jmap to return a valid session with ownerUserId='uid-b', ownerLogin='b@test'
   - Wait for A's discovery task to run one round
   - Assert A's contacts table has a row for uid-b with correct mailbox_host
5. Document a manual test plan for the web UI (block/unblock + EventSource refresh).

Tests: Integration test in kithd tests/ directory.

Defensive programming rules:
- Do not modify any existing test to make it pass (fix the code instead)
- If integration test cannot be written within scope, document why and what manual verification was done instead
